name: Admin User Login Flow
description: Verifies that an administrative user can log in successfully with development credentials and is redirected to the projects landing page.
steps: Navigate to the entry URL http://localhost:8082/?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for Next.js rendering and login screen redirect
Locate the text input with label 'Username' and type 'admin'
Locate the text input with label 'Password' and type 'admin'
Locate the FilledButton or element with text 'LOG IN' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for redirect transition processing
Verify the browser URL path updates to '/projects' and the header or page text 'Projects' is visible

name: Visual Theme Mode Toggle Preference
description: Verifies that users can toggle between light and dark theme modes and settings are applied instantly.
steps: Navigate to the settings URL http://localhost:8082/settings?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for the screen to redirect to the login screen and render
Locate the text input with label 'Username' and type 'admin'
Locate the text input with label 'Password' and type 'admin'
Locate the FilledButton or element with text 'LOG IN' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for login to complete and redirect to the projects landing page
Navigate to the settings URL http://localhost:8082/settings?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for the settings screen to load
Locate the 'Sleek Light Mode' theme option card and click it
Verify the light theme radio option becomes selected
Locate the 'Premium Dark Mode' theme option card and click it
Verify the dark theme radio option becomes selected and the workspace shifts to dark background colors

name: Settings Application Credentials Navigation
description: Verifies that clicking the Application Credentials link in settings successfully scrolls the credentials configurations into view.
steps: Navigate to the settings URL http://localhost:8082/settings?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for the screen to redirect to the login screen and render
Locate the text input with label 'Username' and type 'admin'
Locate the text input with label 'Password' and type 'admin'
Locate the FilledButton or element with text 'LOG IN' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for login to complete and redirect to the projects landing page
Navigate to the settings URL http://localhost:8082/settings?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for the settings screen to load
Locate the sidebar item with text 'Application Credentials' and click it
Wait 1 second for the smooth scrolling viewport alignment to complete
Verify that the main panel header 'Application Credentials' and secure integrations list (like GitHub) is visible

name: Project List to Workspace Navigation Flow
description: Verifies that clicking an existing project from the main projects board successfully routes to the workspace detail interface.
steps: Navigate to the projects list URL http://localhost:8082/projects?enable-semantics=true
Wait 3 seconds for the screen to redirect to the login screen and render
Locate the text input with label 'Username' and type 'admin'
Locate the text input with label 'Password' and type 'admin'
Locate the FilledButton or element with text 'LOG IN' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for login to complete and redirect to the projects landing page
Wait 3 seconds for the projects data query to return cards
Locate the project card with title 'Foundry Showcase' and click it
Wait 3 seconds for transition to workspace and resource configurations loading
Verify the active workspace dashboard page loads and standard subcomponents (Chat Pane, Canvas Pane) are visible
